# @alexify/metaskills

> Agent skills for the Alexis JavaScript stack: reusable instructions for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code and Gemini, linked into a project by one command

- Node.js: >=18.0.0
- License: MIT

## Skills

- [data-structures](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/data-structures/SKILL.md) (library): Build custom JS data structures such as queues, deques, lists, ring buffers, tries, heaps, graphs, LRU caches, CRDTs and pools. Use when Map, Set, Array or Object are not enough
- [error-handling](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/error-handling/SKILL.md) (core): Classify, wrap, retry and report errors in JS, TS and Node.js. Use when code catches, retries or maps failures, or sets process-level error handlers
- [js-conventions](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-conventions/SKILL.md) (core): Alexis JS and TS code style for naming, modules, contracts, iteration, async and performance. Apply when writing, editing, refactoring or reviewing .js, .mjs, .cjs, .ts or .d.ts files
- [js-data-structures](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-data-structures/SKILL.md) (library): Choose native JS collections (Map, Object, Set, Array, WeakMap, TypedArray) for Big-O, semantics and readability. Use when picking a built-in collection
- [js-gof](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-gof/SKILL.md) (design): Apply creational and structural GoF patterns in JS and TS, such as factory, builder, singleton, pool, adapter, decorator, proxy, bridge and facade. Use when implementing or naming one
- [metautil-data-structures](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/metautil-data-structures/SKILL.md) (library): Operate metautil ADTs (ConsList, Struct, Queue, Stack, Deque, List, Trie, UnrolledList, CircularBuffer). Use when importing or calling these classes from metautil
- [npm-publish](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/npm-publish/SKILL.md) (library): Prepare an @alexify package release with pnpm, covering version bump, CHANGELOG, typings, gates, docs and pack check. Use when asked to prepare a release or publish
